title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 5000K Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 5000K Series Hub fan assemblies offer years of cost effective, reliable service. Cooling Tower replacement parts from ICST.

layout.title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 5000K Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 20′ Through 30′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 6 to 12.

Hudson Tuf-Lite III 5000K Series Hub (White, previously Teal Green) fan blades are of single piece fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) construction optimized for performance, reliability, noise, and cost effectiveness. Tuf-Lite IIIﾨ fan blades are constructed of light weight, corrosion resistant, fiberglass reinforced vinyl-ester resin, with materials, thickness, and processes determined from finite element analysis modeling. Tuf-Edge leading-edge erosion and UV protection come standard with this blade.
